proposals.after: Wu Dexiao and his son Zhongtao; Cheng Zhaolin
proposals.reason: 潚 is standardly read xiāo; 'Desi' misrenders 德潚, which should be Dexiao.

proposals.after: Wu Dexiao and his son Zhongtao; Cheng Zhaolin

proposals.before: In Guangxu 26 the Boxer uprising erupted, the allied armies of the foreign powers took the capital, and Emperor Guangxu led Empress Dowager Cixi west in flight. Yigong, who had long enjoyed the dynasty's favor, was unable to join the imperial flight and burned himself to death.
proposals.after: In Guangxu 26 the Boxer uprising erupted, the allied armies of the foreign powers took the capital, and Emperor Guangxu escorted Empress Dowager Cixi west in flight. Yigong, who had long enjoyed the dynasty's favor, was unable to join the imperial flight and burned himself to death.
proposals.reason: 奉 means the emperor escorted/attended the empress dowager westward; 'led' reverses the deference implied by 德宗奉孝欽顯皇后西狩.

proposals.before: In the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu the Boxers began the calamity; the allied armies of the powers broke the capital; Emperor Dezong escorted Empress Dowager Xiaojin the Manifest west on tour; Yigong, having received the state's grace through generations, could not follow the imperial retinue, and set himself afire.
proposals.after: In the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu the Boxers began the calamity; the allied armies of the powers broke the capital; Emperor Dezong escorted Empress Dowager Xiaojinxian west on tour; Yigong, having received the state's grace through generations, could not follow the imperial retinue, and set himself afire.
proposals.reason: 孝欽顯皇后 is the posthumous title Xiaojinxian; splitting it as 'Xiaojin the Manifest' obscures the standard posthumous name.

proposals.before: He was selected within the capital to be metropolitan prefect of Shuntian, resigned on illness, and was recalled as a Hanlin reader in the Grand Secretariat.
proposals.after: He was selected within the capital to be metropolitan prefect of Shuntian, resigned on illness, and was recalled as a reader-attendant academician in the Grand Secretariat.
proposals.reason: 內閣侍讀學士 is a Grand Secretariat reader-attendant post, not a Hanlin Academy appointment; 'Hanlin reader' invents the wrong institution.
